claim_en: SEPARATION. Onkelos's separating verb; Israel's not gentiles'; one analogy carrying time, death, and acceptance; the addressees.
THE KARET EXTENSION. All holy things; the four-way difference; the readiness threshold; body-impurity by four routes.
THE MEASURES CENSUS. Aaron himself; tithe as tevul yom; sunset; contact; the Lev 5:3 measures; the swallower.
THE MIXTURE GRID. One-in-a-hundred both directions; whole-body immersion; sunset gates terumah, atonement does not.
THE GULLET CARVE. Bird only; the court's charge; not the tithe; the eater's state; Onkelos's receive-a-debt.
THE STRANGER. Every non-priest; olive; terumah; forever vs years; the uncircumcised by two routes.
THE HOUSEHOLD FEEDER. Wife, slaves, slaves' slaves; Hebrew and half-slave out; the worthless-born; the son feeds the mother; the dead feed none.

source: Sifra, Emor, Section 5 7-10 + Section 6 1 + Onkelos Lev 22:12
claim_en: THE DAUGHTER TO A STRANGER. To one who feeds; she feeds her mother; terumah vs holy things crossed.

source: Sifra, Emor, Chapter 5 1-5 + Chapter 6 1 + Onkelos Lev 22:13
claim_en: THE RETURN. No seed to the seed's seed; the grandson high priest; unfit seed counts; not the levirate-bound, not the pregnant.
THE FIFTH. Non-strangers exempt; nine-and-a-day a man; it-and-its-fifth are five; payment material; kind for kind; giving sanctifies.
THE PROFANERS. Anointer and drinker; raised not untithed; death even on the untithed; sower and defiler out; Onkelos's inserted 'in impurity.'
